Edward Murphy Kelahan (born January 9, 1968) is an American actor, producer, and stunt performer. He has appeared in television, film, and commercial productions, and co-created independent television projects.
Early life and education
Kelahan was born in Amityville, Long Island, New York, to Thomas and Kathleen Kelahan. He has three brothers—Benjamin, Paul, and Joseph Kelahan—and one sister, Clare Kelahan.
He trained in acting at Maria Greco’s Dove Tails Actors Resources, Scene Study & Commercial Class in Manhattan; Ted Bardy Studio (Meisner Technique); CNC Studios with Jagger Kaye (Commercial Class/Scene Study); Clayton Fletcher’s Stand Up Comedy in Manhattan; and Drivers East Stunt Driving School for vehicle stunts and precision driving.
Career
Kelahan has worked in television, film, and commercial productions.
Television
* Co-star as DC Officer in NBC's The Blacklist (Episode: "Fredrick Barnes")
* Co-star as Paramedic in NBC's Unforgettable (Episode: "Maps & Legends")
* Co-star as Phillip Carroll in Showtime's Billions (Episode: "Currency")
* Co-star as Juror #7 in NBC's Bull (Episode: "Justice for Cable")
* Co-star as Patrolman #1 in HBO's The Deuce (Episode: "We're All Beasts")
* Guest anchor on CNN's Anderson Cooper 360 for the 30th Anniversary Space Shuttle Challenger Disaster
* Recurring role as Desk Officer in NTD's A Good Cop
Film
* Supporting role and stunts as an undercover detective in Revenge of the Green Dragons
* Supporting and stunt driver role as NYPD in Tracers
* Supporting role as Ron, the delivery driver, in Furlough
* Supporting role as Officer Callahan in To Live and Die in BedStuy
* Supporting role as Sol in Honor Among Thieves
* Supporting role as ICE Agent #1 in Sanctuary
Comedy and Commercial Work
Kelahan appeared in Comedy Central Originals as a recurring Police Officer in Mini Mocks, and co-starred as Father in Yule Hide and Arresting Police Officer in The Alec Baldwin Special. He has appeared in commercials for brands including Deer Park Water, Cognizant, Verizon, Lays, Footlocker, Audi, Chevy, Toyota, and Doritos.
Television Production
He co-hosted ADTV (Attention Deficit Television) with Rose Iebba and co-created Cuffs & Shield with Mauricio Ovalle. He also Produced independent films including The Last Minutes, Cuffs & Shield, Despair, and The Cover Up.
